title: Pickup day
summary: Have your licence and card, check the car in with photos and the readings, and drive off.

steps.text: On your booking, finish anything still needed before pickup.
At the car, open Check in (pickup) on your booking.
Take photos of every side, inside and any damage, then the dashboard photo for the km and fuel.
Press Check in. Your photos and readings go on the check-in report.
